mapper.insert: insert into forum_post (post_id, title, content, category_id, stu_number, username, user_image, view_count, like_count, comment_count, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{postId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{categoryId}, #{stuNumber}, #{username}, #{userImage}, 0, 0, 0, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select p.post_id, p.title, p.content, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.stu_number, p.username, p.user_image, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.create_time from forum_post p left join forum_category c on p.category_id = c.id
p.status = 1
and p.category_id = #{categoryId}
order by p.create_time desc

select p.post_id, p.title, p.content, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.stu_number, p.username, p.user_image, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.create_time from forum_post p left join forum_category c on p.category_id = c.id where p.post_id = #{postId} and p.status = 1

select p.post_id, p.title, p.content, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.stu_number, p.username, p.user_image, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.create_time from forum_post p left join forum_category c on p.category_id = c.id where p.stu_number = #{stuNumber} and p.status = 1 order by p.create_time desc
